Your home state got hit with a hurricane, a mudslide and a wildfire, and your administration bungled the response. Repairing the PR damage will cost you $1 million for each Electoral Vote in your state.
Move yourself to either Indiana or Arizona, free of charge, and claim the Electoral Vote chip for that state. If someone else already has it, they must give it to you.
Every candidate wearing socks must give you $1 million.
